description: Write a function with docstring — validate email
prompt: Write a Python function `validate_email(address)` that checks if an email address is valid. Include a complete docstring with Args and Returns sections. Use STE-Code principles: approved words, active voice, no jargon.

description: Write a function that processes data with proper error handling
prompt: Write a TypeScript function `processPayload(data: unknown)` that validates and transforms an API payload. Include JSDoc with @param and @returns. Use STE-Code: active voice, no slang, clear error descriptions.

description: Write an async function with clear error states documented
prompt: Write a JavaScript async function `fetchUserData(userId)` that reads from an API. Document all error states in the JSDoc. Use STE-Code: one term per concept, no "fetch" → use "read", no passive voice.

description: Write a class with full method documentation
prompt: Write a Python class `UserService` with methods `register`, `authenticate`, and `delete`. Each method needs a STE-Code compliant docstring. Use approved verbs from the STE-Code synonym table. Use imperative mood for summaries.
